unexpectedMethodsRationale: The coverage phase probes each documented path with methods it does not declare. It may send only what the scanner gateway relays, because a method the gateway refuses is answered by the harness rather than by the deployment under assessment. TRACE, CONNECT and TRACK are rejected at the proxy and observed there by the passive deployment stage instead.

excludedOperations.getApiDocument: The SECURITY deployment does not expose its source contract through the assessed proxy.
excludedOperations.logIn: Authentication enumeration and rate limiting are covered by CSA-AUTHN-001.
excludedOperations.logOut: Session invalidation is covered by CSA-AUTHN-001 and browser security journeys.
excludedOperations.changeInitialPassword: The bootstrap-only transition is covered by packaged browser security journeys.
excludedOperations.createImportPreview: Multipart parser abuse is covered by the curated CSA-IMPORT-001 cases.
excludedOperations.executeImportPreview: Import execution is stateful and remains covered by deterministic import integration tests.

positiveMutationRationale: Valid mutations are covered by packaged journeys and the authorization matrix; generated mutation traffic is restricted to rejected inputs so state preservation remains attributable.
